segments.name: Wound care
segments.description: Develops and markets noninvasive ultrasound directed-energy products, primarily the UltraMIST system, for treating acute and chronic wounds.
segments.evidence: Sanuwave is a medical device company providing directed energy products into the wound care space.

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly U.S. healthcare providers, buy UltraMIST systems and then purchase sterile single-use applicators for each treatment under a razor/razor blade model.
revenueModel.evidence: UltraMIST is sold using a simple "razor/razor blade" model. Customers purchase an UltraMIST system and then each treatment utilizes a sterile, single use applicator sold in cases of 12.
